# Scale SEAL Leaderboards: Frontier Model Performance Across 20+ Benchmarks

## Source
https://scale.com/leaderboard

## Overview

Scale Labs maintains a comprehensive suite of over 20 AI benchmarks evaluating 100+ models from leading labs including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, and open-source contributors. The benchmarks span four categories: **Agentic** (coding and tool use), **Frontier** (reasoning and knowledge), **Safety** (alignment and honesty), and **Multimodal** (audio and vision-language). The leaderboards combine private datasets to prevent overfitting with open-source datasets for comparability. All scores include confidence intervals.

## Agentic Coding Benchmarks

OpenAI's GPT-5.4 variants dominate software engineering tasks, while Claude Opus 4.6 competes strongly on private repositories.

| Benchmark | #1 Model | Score | #2 Model | Score | #3 Model | Score |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SWE Atlas – Test Writing | GPT-5.4-xHigh (Codex CLI) | 44.36 ±6.04 | GPT-5.4-xHigh (Mini-SWE) | 40.00 ±6.00 | GPT-5.3-Codex-Xhigh | 38.98 ±6.12 |
| SWE Atlas – Codebase QnA | GPT 5.4 xHigh (Codex) | 40.80 ±5.10 | GPT 5.4 xHigh (Mini-SWE) | 36.30 ±4.90 | Opus 4.6 (Claude Code) | 33.30 ±5.00 |
| MCP Atlas (Tool Use) | Muse Spark | 78.30 ±2.40 | Claude Opus 4.6 | 75.80 ±3.00 | Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview | 73.90 ±2.50 |
| SWE-Bench Pro (Public) | GPT-5.4-pro (xHigh) | 59.10 ±3.56 | Muse Spark | 55.00 ±3.60 | Claude Opus 4.6 | 51.90 ±3.61 |
| SWE-Bench Pro (Private) | Claude Opus 4.6 | 47.10 ±6.07 | Muse Spark | 44.70 ±6.05 | GPT-5.4-pro (xHigh) | 43.40 ±6.03 |

Notably, Muse Spark (a new entrant) appears in the top 3 on MCP Atlas, SWE-Bench Pro (Public and Private), and multiple other benchmarks.

## Frontier Reasoning & Knowledge Benchmarks

These benchmarks test the limits of model reasoning. Scores remain well below saturation, indicating significant room for improvement.

| Benchmark | #1 Model | Score | #2 Model | Score | #3 Model | Score |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Humanity's Last Exam | GPT-5.4-pro | 44.32 ±1.95 | Muse Spark | 40.56 ±1.92 | Gemini-3-pro-preview | 37.52 ±1.90 |
| HLE (Text Only) | GPT-5.4-pro | 45.32 ±2.10 | Muse Spark | 40.92 ±2.07 | Gemini-3-pro-preview | 37.72 ±2.04 |
| EnigmaEval | GPT-5.4-pro | 23.82 ±2.43 | Gemini-3.1 | 19.76 ±2.27 | GPT-5-pro-2025 | 18.75 ±2.22 |
| MultiChallenge | Muse Spark | 75.52 ±4.05 | Gemini-3.1-pro-preview | 71.37 ±1.74 | GPT-5.4-pro | 69.23 ±3.05 |
| MultiNRC (Multilingual) | GPT-5-pro | 65.20 ±1.24 | Gemini-3.1-pro | 64.74 ±2.88 | GPT-5.4-pro | 62.27 ±2.92 |
| SciPredict | Gemini-3-pro-preview | 25.27 ±1.92 | Claude Opus 4.5 | 23.05 ±0.51 | Claude Opus 4.1 | 22.22 ±1.48 |

EnigmaEval scores (under 24%) and SciPredict scores (under 26%) highlight how far models remain from solving complex multi-step reasoning and scientific forecasting tasks.

## Multimodal: Audio & Vision-Language

Google's Gemini models dominate audio and vision-language understanding benchmarks.

![AudioMultiChallenge - Audio Output leaderboard showing Gemini 3.1 Flash Live at 36.06 vs GPT-Realtime-1.5 at 34.73](./assets/figure_1.jpg)

![EnigmaEval leaderboard showing GPT-5.4-pro at 23.82 leading Gemini-3.1 at 19.76](./assets/figure_2.jpg)

![VISTA Vision-Language benchmark showing Gemini 2.5 Pro at 54.65 and GPT-5.4-pro at 53.89](./assets/figure_3.jpg)

**AudioMultiChallenge (Text Output):** Gemini-3-pro-preview leads at 54.65 ±4.57, followed by Gemini-2.5-pro at 46.90 and Gemini-2.5-flash at 40.04. **Audio Output:** Gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview leads at 36.06 ±4.41 over GPT-realtime-1.5 at 34.73. **VISTA (Vision-Language):** Gemini 2.5 Pro Experimental leads at 54.65 ±1.46, with GPT-5.4-pro close behind at 53.89 ±2.02. **VisualToolBench:** GPT-5.4 edges Gemini-3.1-pro (29.17 vs 28.97).

## Safety & Alignment Benchmarks

| Benchmark | #1 Model | Score | #2 Model | Score |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| MASK (Honesty) | Claude Opus 4.6 | 96.28 ±0.41 | Claude Sonnet 4 | 96.13 ±0.57 |
| PropensityBench (lower=better) | o3-2025-04-16 | 10.50 ±0.60 | Claude Sonnet 4 | — |
| Fortress (National Security) | — | 8.24 ±1.93 | Claude Sonnet 4 | 12.80 ±2.36 |
| Professional Reasoning – Legal | Claude Opus 4.6 | 52.27 ±0.66 | — | — |
| Professional Reasoning – Finance | Claude Opus 4.6 | 53.28 ±0.18 | Muse Spark | 52.44 ±0.06 |
| Remote Labor Index (RLI) | Claude Opus 4.6 (CoWo) | 4.17 | Claude Opus 4.5 | 3.75 |

Anthropic's Claude models dominate safety and professional reasoning benchmarks. MASK honesty scores are near ceiling (96%), while Fortress national security scores remain very low (8–13), suggesting significant difficulty.

## Key Findings

- **No single model wins everywhere:** GPT-5.4 leads agentic coding and frontier reasoning, Gemini dominates audio/vision, and Claude leads safety and professional reasoning.
- **Benchmarks remain unsaturated:** Top scores on Humanity's Last Exam (44%), EnigmaEval (24%), and SciPredict (25%) show frontier models still have substantial room for improvement.
- **Muse Spark emerges as a strong new competitor**, placing in the top 3 on at least 6 benchmarks including MultiChallenge (#1 at 75.5%), HLE, SWE-Bench Pro, and MCP Atlas.
- **Gemini sweeps audio benchmarks** with all top-3 positions on AudioMultiChallenge (Text Output) held by Gemini variants, and leads VISTA vision-language understanding.
- **Claude's safety dominance is clear** with 96%+ on MASK honesty and #1 on both professional reasoning benchmarks (Legal and Finance), but Fortress scores remain critically low across all models.

# Scale SEAL Leaderboards: Frontier Model Performance Across 20+ Benchmarks

## Source
https://scale.com/leaderboard

## Overview

Scale Labs maintains a comprehensive suite of over 20 AI benchmarks evaluating 100+ models from leading labs including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, and open-source contributors. The benchmarks span four categories: **Agentic** (coding and tool use), **Frontier** (reasoning and knowledge), **Safety** (alignment and honesty), and **Multimodal** (audio and vision-language). The leaderboards combine private datasets to prevent overfitting with open-source datasets for comparability. All scores include confidence intervals.

## Agentic Coding Benchmarks

OpenAI's GPT-5.4 variants dominate software engineering tasks, while Claude Opus 4.6 competes strongly on private repositories.

| Benchmark | #1 Model | Score | #2 Model | Score | #3 Model | Score |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SWE Atlas – Test Writing | GPT-5.4-xHigh (Codex CLI) | 44.36 ±6.04 | GPT-5.4-xHigh (Mini-SWE) | 40.00 ±6.00 | GPT-5.3-Codex-Xhigh | 38.98 ±6.12 |
| SWE Atlas – Codebase QnA | GPT 5.4 xHigh (Codex) | 40.80 ±5.10 | GPT 5.4 xHigh (Mini-SWE) | 36.30 ±4.90 | Opus 4.6 (Claude Code) | 33.30 ±5.00 |
| MCP Atlas (Tool Use) | Muse Spark | 78.30 ±2.40 | Claude Opus 4.6 | 75.80 ±3.00 | Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview | 73.90 ±2.50 |

| SWE-Bench Pro (Private) | Claude Opus 4.6 | 47.10 ±6.07 | Muse Spark | 44.70 ±6.05 | GPT-5.4-pro (xHigh) | 43.40 ±6.03 |

Notably, Muse Spark (a new entrant) appears in the top 3 on MCP Atlas, SWE-Bench Pro (Public and Private), and multiple other benchmarks.

## Frontier Reasoning & Knowledge Benchmarks

These benchmarks test the limits of model reasoning. Scores remain well below saturation, indicating significant room for improvement.

| Benchmark | #1 Model | Score | #2 Model | Score | #3 Model | Score |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Humanity's Last Exam | GPT-5.4-pro | 44.32 ±1.95 | Muse Spark | 40.56 ±1.92 | Gemini-3-pro-preview | 37.52 ±1.90 |
| HLE (Text Only) | GPT-5.4-pro | 45.32 ±2.10 | Muse Spark | 40.92 ±2.07 | Gemini-3-pro-preview | 37.72 ±2.04 |
| EnigmaEval | GPT-5.4-pro | 23.82 ±2.43 | Gemini-3.1 | 19.76 ±2.27 | GPT-5-pro-2025 | 18.75 ±2.22 |
| MultiChallenge | Muse Spark | 75.52 ±4.05 | Gemini-3.1-pro-preview | 71.37 ±1.74 | GPT-5.4-pro | 69.23 ±3.05 |

EnigmaEval scores (under 24%) and SciPredict scores (under 26%) highlight how far models remain from solving complex multi-step reasoning and scientific forecasting tasks.

Google's Gemini models dominate audio and vision-language understanding benchmarks.

- **Claude's safety dominance is clear** with 96%+ on MASK honesty and #1 on both professional reasoning benchmarks (Legal and Finance), but Fortress scores remain critically low across all models.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build Scale SEAL Leaderboard analysis deck (8 slides, 16:9)."""

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt, Emu
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN, MSO_ANCHOR
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE
from pptx.enum.chart import XL_CHART_TYPE, XL_LEGEND_POSITION, XL_LABEL_POSITION
from pptx.chart.data import CategoryChartData
import math

# ── Constants ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
SLIDE_W = Inches(13.333)
SLIDE_H = Inches(7.5)

# Lab colors
C_OPENAI   = RGBColor(0x10, 0xA3, 0x7F)   # teal-green
C_GOOGLE   = RGBColor(0x42, 0x85, 0xF4)   # blue
C_ANTHRO   = RGBColor(0xD9, 0x7A, 0x2B)   # warm orange
C_MUSE     = RGBColor(0xAB, 0x47, 0xBC)   # purple
C_DARK     = RGBColor(0x1A, 0x1A, 0x2E)   # navy-charcoal bg
C_DARK2    = RGBColor(0x22, 0x22, 0x3A)
C_WHITE    = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)
C_LGRAY    = RGBColor(0xCC, 0xCC, 0xCC)
C_MGRAY    = RGBColor(0x99, 0x99, 0x99)
C_ACCENT   = RGBColor(0x00, 0xD4, 0xAA)   # bright teal accent
C_RED      = RGBColor(0xE5, 0x4D, 0x42)   # for low/warning
C_GREEN    = RGBColor(0x4C, 0xAF, 0x50)   # for high/good
C_YELLOW   = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xC1, 0x07)


def set_slide_bg(slide, color):
    bg = slide.background
    fill = bg.fill
    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb = color


def add_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=18,
                color=C_WHITE, bold=False, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT,
                font_name="Calibri"):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = text
    p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    p.font.color.rgb = color
    p.font.bold = bold
    p.font.name = font_name
    p.alignment = alignment
    return txBox


def add_shape_rect(slide, left, top, width, height, fill_color, border_color=None):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    if border_color:
        shape.line.color.rgb = border_color
        shape.line.width = Pt(1)
    else:
        shape.line.fill.background()
    return shape


def add_multiline_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, lines, font_size=14,
                          color=C_WHITE, bold=False, line_spacing=1.3, font_name="Calibri"):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if i == 0:
            p = tf.paragraphs[0]
        else:
            p = tf.add_paragraph()
        txt = line if isinstance(line, str) else line[0]
        fs = font_size if isinstance(line, str) else line[1]
        b = bold if isinstance(line, str) else (line[2] if len(line) > 2 else bold)
        c = color if isinstance(line, str) else (line[3] if len(line) > 3 else color)
        p.text = txt
        p.font.size = Pt(fs)
        p.font.color.rgb = c
        p.font.bold = b
        p.font.name = font_name
        p.space_after = Pt(font_size * (line_spacing - 1) * 1.5)
    return txBox


# ── Presentation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
prs = Presentation()
prs.slide_width = SLIDE_W
prs.slide_height = SLIDE_H
blank_layout = prs.slide_layouts[6]  # blank


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SLIDE 1 — Title
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
sl = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
set_slide_bg(sl, C_DARK)

# accent bar at top
add_shape_rect(sl, Inches(0), Inches(0), SLIDE_W, Inches(0.06), C_ACCENT)

add_textbox(sl, Inches(1.2), Inches(1.8), Inches(11), Inches(1.2),
            "Scale SEAL Leaderboards", 42, C_WHITE, True)
add_textbox(sl, Inches(1.2), Inches(2.9), Inches(11), Inches(1),
            "Frontier Model Performance Across 20+ AI Benchmarks", 26, C_ACCENT, False)

lines = [
    "100+ models evaluated  |  4 capability domains  |  Private + public datasets",
    "",
    "Agentic Coding  ·  Frontier Reasoning  ·  Safety & Alignment  ·  Multimodal",
]
add_multiline_textbox(sl, Inches(1.2), Inches(4.3), Inches(10), Inches(2),
                      lines, 16, C_LGRAY)

add_textbox(sl, Inches(1.2), Inches(6.4), Inches(6), Inches(0.5),
            "Source: scale.com/leaderboard  |  April 2026", 12, C_MGRAY)

# Lab color legend
legend_y = Inches(6.4)
legend_items = [("OpenAI", C_OPENAI), ("Google", C_GOOGLE), ("Anthropic", C_ANTHRO), ("Muse Spark", C_MUSE)]
x_start = Inches(8.0)
for lab, clr in legend_items:
    add_shape_rect(sl, x_start, legend_y, Inches(0.2), Inches(0.2), clr)
    add_textbox(sl, x_start + Inches(0.28), legend_y - Inches(0.02), Inches(1.2), Inches(0.3),
                lab, 11, C_LGRAY)
    x_start += Inches(1.4)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SLIDE 2 — Benchmark Landscape Overview
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
sl = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
set_slide_bg(sl, C_DARK)
add_shape_rect(sl, Inches(0), Inches(0), SLIDE_W, Inches(0.06), C_ACCENT)

add_textbox(sl, Inches(0.8), Inches(0.3), Inches(12), Inches(0.7),
            "20+ Benchmarks Spanning Four Capability Domains Evaluate 100+ Models",
            26, C_WHITE, True)
add_textbox(sl, Inches(0.8), Inches(1.0), Inches(12), Inches(0.5),
            "Private datasets prevent overfitting; open-source datasets ensure comparability. All scores include confidence intervals.",
            13, C_LGRAY)

domains = [
    ("AGENTIC", C_OPENAI,
     ["SWE Atlas – Test Writing", "SWE Atlas – Codebase QnA",
      "MCP Atlas (Tool Use)", "SWE-Bench Pro (Public)", "SWE-Bench Pro (Private)"]),
    ("FRONTIER", C_YELLOW,
     ["Humanity's Last Exam", "HLE (Text Only)", "EnigmaEval",
      "MultiChallenge", "MultiNRC", "SciPredict"]),
    ("SAFETY", C_ANTHRO,
     ["MASK (Honesty)", "PropensityBench", "Fortress (Natl Security)",
      "Prof. Reasoning – Legal", "Prof. Reasoning – Finance", "Remote Labor Index"]),
    ("MULTIMODAL", C_GOOGLE,
     ["AudioMultiChallenge (Text)", "AudioMultiChallenge (Audio)",
      "VISTA (Vision-Language)", "VisualToolBench"]),
]

card_w = Inches(2.8)
card_h = Inches(4.5)
gap = Inches(0.35)
start_x = Inches(0.65)
start_y = Inches(1.7)

for i, (title, accent, benchmarks) in enumerate(domains):
    x = start_x + i * (card_w + gap)
    card = add_shape_rect(sl, x, start_y, card_w, card_h, C_DARK2, RGBColor(0x44, 0x44, 0x55))
    # accent top stripe
    add_shape_rect(sl, x, start_y, card_w, Inches(0.05), accent)
    add_textbox(sl, x + Inches(0.2), start_y + Inches(0.2), card_w - Inches(0.4), Inches(0.4),
                title, 16, accent, True)
    bench_lines = [(b, 11, False, C_LGRAY) for b in benchmarks]
    add_multiline_textbox(sl, x + Inches(0.2), start_y + Inches(0.75),
                          card_w - Inches(0.4), card_h - Inches(1),
                          bench_lines, 11, C_LGRAY, line_spacing=1.5)

add_textbox(sl, Inches(0.8), Inches(6.5), Inches(11), Inches(0.5),
            "Suite maintained by Scale Labs  —  combining private & open-source evaluation datasets",
            11, C_MGRAY)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SLIDE 3 — Agentic Coding Leaders (Table)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
sl = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
set_slide_bg(sl, C_DARK)
add_shape_rect(sl, Inches(0), Inches(0), SLIDE_W, Inches(0.06), C_ACCENT)

add_textbox(sl, Inches(0.6), Inches(0.3), Inches(12), Inches(0.7),
            "GPT-5.4 Dominates Agentic Coding: Top Scores on SWE Atlas & SWE-Bench Pro",
            24, C_WHITE, True)
add_textbox(sl, Inches(0.6), Inches(0.95), Inches(12), Inches(0.5),
            "Muse Spark emerges top-3 on 3/5 agentic benchmarks; Claude Opus 4.6 leads private repo evaluation",
            13, C_LGRAY)

# Table data
headers = ["Benchmark", "#1 Model", "Score", "#2 Model", "Score", "#3 Model", "Score"]
rows = [
    ["SWE Atlas – Test Writing",
     "GPT-5.4-xHigh\n(Codex CLI)", "44.36", "GPT-5.4-xHigh\n(Mini-SWE)", "40.00", "GPT-5.3-Codex\nXhigh", "38.98"],
    ["SWE Atlas – Codebase QnA",

    ["MCP Atlas\n(Tool Use)",

]

# Model -> lab color mapping
def model_color(name):

    if "gpt" in n or "o3" in n or "o1" in n:

    if "claude" in n or "opus" in n or "sonnet" in n:

table_top = Inches(1.65)
table_w = Inches(12.5)
n_rows = len(rows) + 1
n_cols = len(headers)
row_h = Inches(0.85)
tbl_h = row_h * n_rows

tbl_shape = sl.shapes.add_table(n_rows, n_cols, table_left, table_top, table_w, tbl_h)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

def set_slide_bg(slide, color):
    bg = slide.background

def add_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=18,
                color=C_WHITE, bold=False, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT,
                font_name="Calibri"):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = text
    p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    p.font.color.rgb = color
    p.font.bold = bold
    p.font.name = font_name
    p.alignment = alignment
    return txBox


def add_shape_rect(slide, left, top, width, height, fill_color, border_color=None):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    if border_color:
        shape.line.color.rgb = border_color
        shape.line.width = Pt(1)
    else:
        shape.line.fill.background()
    return shape

        p.font.bold = b

    return txBox
